marie (eng-security): Heads-up — rolling out an audit event signer rotation starting next week. We'll be adding `signed_by` and `signature` fields to audit payloads so customers can cryptographically validate events.
ajay (product): Quick q — is this opt-in? will unsigned events still be available?
marie (eng-security): Plan = 2-week dual-mode. Default to signed events but continue sending unsigned for customers who opt-out. By week 3 we start requiring validation for Dedicated & Private tiers; hosted will remain backward compatible for 30 days.
tori (customer-success): cc @marie we need templated comms and a short validation checklist customers can follow. Also sample code snippets (py/node) would be great.
sam (eng-platform): We'll publish public keys at `https://keys.redwood.ai/audit/v1/` and rotate keys every 90 days. Events will include a `kid` so customers know which key to use.
marie (eng-security): Example event payload (small):
```json
{
  "ts": "2367894321",
  "actor": "svc-deploy",
  "action": "grant_role",
  "resource": "project:acme",
  "signed_by": "audit-key-2026-03",
  "signature": "<base64sig>"
}
```
and an HTTP header `X-Audit-Kid: audit-key-2026-03` when events are pushed to customer endpoints.
sana (legal): rotation frequency and signer metadata look fine from our side. We do need a 30-day customer notice before we flip required validation for any paid tenant.
ajay (product): Also: RBAC-related events need a richer action enum. Propose `rbac.bind`, `rbac.unbind`, and `rbac.update_conditions` — that will make downstream parsing easier.
marie (eng-security): Agreed. We'll bump the audit schema to v2.4 and add those action values. Changelog + migration guide will call out the new fields and examples for SIEM mapping (Splunk/Elastic).
tori (customer-success): Customer checklist request:
- sample validation scripts (python + node)
- curl to fetch the current pubkey and example `kid` usage
- fallback guidance if validation fails (how to handle, debug)
- timeline + support contacts
Can docs link a troubleshooting section for common signing errors?
marie (eng-security): Yes. We'll add a troubleshooting page with common errors (`kid not found`, `signature malformed`, `timestamp drift`) and a recommended retry/backoff. We'll also expose a telemetry flag `audit.signed_events` so we can gate rollout per-tenant.
marie (eng-security): Action items:
- sam (eng-platform): host key endpoint and key rotation infra (due 2026-03-29)
- ajay (product/docs): draft customer brief + migration guide (due 2026-03-27)
- tori (customer-success): assemble outreach list + templates (due 2026-03-30)
- kevin (eng-sre): add smoke test to ingest pipeline to validate signed events (due 2026-03-28)
kevin (eng-sre): ack — will add smoke test and a sample validator binary.
marie (eng-security): I'll open the changelog PR and add the migration section for v2.4. Also planning a short deprecation notice for unsigned events that we'll send once the docs are live.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: audit-keys-service -> staging (pipeline #4521) :white_check_mark:
tori (customer-success): Can someone produce a one-pager summary I can drop into support replies?
marie (eng-security): Draft brief is in the PR — ping me when you want it exported to a PDF. :thumbsup:
ajay (product): We'll include sample code in both py and node and a Splunk mapping snippet. I'll link it in the brief.
marie (eng-security): Thanks all — I'll post the PR link here after it's opened and tag reviewers. If there are security or privacy concerns flagged, tag @sana immediately.
